input.question: Why it is so hard to remember our dreams ?
input.ground_truth: because they're considered irrelevant by our brains. you can train yourself in recollection. that's done mostly by writing down any shreds you do remember, as quickly as you can after you've had the dream.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why it is so hard to remember our dreams ?

Answer:

response.prediction: Okay! Imagine your brain is like a little box where you keep your toys. At night, when you sleep, your brain plays with lots of fun pictures and stories—those are your dreams! But when you wake up, your brain is like, “Oh no! I forgot to put the dream toys in the toy box where I can find them!” That’s why it’s really hard to remember your dreams when you wake up. Your brain just doesn’t save them very well, like how sometimes you forget where you put your favorite toy.
